def: In the EU AI Act, an AI incident or malfunction leading, directly or indirectly, to death or serious health harm, serious irreversible critical-infrastructure disruption, fundamental-rights infringement, or serious property or environmental harm.
practice: Article 73 makes providers of high-risk systems report to market surveillance authorities within 15 days of becoming aware, 10 days for a death and 2 days for widespread infringements or critical-infrastructure disruption, so runbooks need the legal clock; information, not legal advice.
